fusions.name: Hoofbeat Run
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles toward the target and hurl a stinger that deals 15 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Trailing Barb
fusions.desc: A stinger flung from the run that deals 8 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4. Once every 6 seconds.
